meta.title: Set Up Your Business | Connection Pilot
meta.description: Tell Pilot about your business and confirm the details for a personalized Connection Pilot workspace.

hero.title: Tell Pilot about your business.
hero.description: One quick note is all it takes. I’ll pull out the essentials and show you what I understood before anything is saved.
hero.pilotMessage: Share your business name, what you do, where your business is located, your hours, and the services you offer — naturally, in your own words.

prompt.label: Your business, in a few words
prompt.placeholder: I own a bakery called Staci Bakes in Windsor. We’re open Tuesday to Saturday from 9–5 and sell cakes, cupcakes, cookies and pastries.
prompt.helper: No need to format it perfectly. Pilot will organize the details for you.

supplemental.title: Add more information (optional)
supplemental.description: Tell Pilot is all you need. Add a website or a file only if you have more details to share.
supplemental.fileLabel: Upload a menu, price list, PDF, or service list
supplemental.fileHelp: Choose a text, CSV, or PDF file up to 1 MB.

review.title: Here’s what I heard.
